import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

This guide walks you through setting up **AptosKit** and fetching data on the
Aptos blockchain.

<Steps>
  1. Install the SDK

     **AptosKit** is available as a Swift package. Add the following to your
     `Package.swift` file:

     ```swift filename="Package.swift"
     dependencies: [
       .package(url: "https://github.com/mcxross/swift-aptos.git", .upToNextMajor(from: <version>))
     ]
     ```

  2. Import the SDK

     ```swift filename="Main.swift"
     import AptosKit
     ```

  3. Create the configuration

     `AptosConfig` is the single entry point for all client settings. Set the
     target network and any optional overrides.

     ```swift filename="Main.swift"
     let aptosConfig = AptosConfig(network: .devnet)
     ```

  4. Create the Aptos client

     The `Aptos` object is the entry point for all blockchain interactions. Its
     namespaced services (`ledger`, `accounts`, `transactions`, etc.) mirror the
     Kotlin API.

     ```swift filename="Main.swift"
     let aptos = Aptos(config: aptosConfig)
     ```

  5. Fetch the chain ID

     ```swift filename="Main.swift"
     let state = try await aptos.ledger.info()
     print("Chain ID: \(state.chainId)")
     ```

     Congratulations! You have successfully set up **AptosKit** and read ledger
     data from the Aptos blockchain.
</Steps>

## Complete Example

```swift filename="Main.swift"
import SwiftUI
import AptosKit

struct ContentView: View {
  @State private var chainId: String? = nil

  var body: some View {
    VStack {
      if let chainId = chainId {
        Text("Chain ID: \(chainId)")
      } else {
        Text("Fetching Chain ID...")
      }
    }
    .padding()
    .onAppear {
      fetchChainId()
    }
  }

  private func fetchChainId() {
    Task {
      do {
        let aptosConfig = AptosConfig(network: .devnet)
        let aptos = Aptos(config: aptosConfig)

        let state = try await aptos.ledger.info()
        await MainActor.run {
          self.chainId = "\(state.chainId)"
        }
      } catch {
        print("Failed to get chain ID: \(error)")
        await MainActor.run {
          self.chainId = "Error"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
